comment: The DSP is Émilie Gillet's Warps, vendored unchanged at eurorack/warps; src/incurvationes.cpp is the Rack wrapper, running one modulator per polyphonic channel. The level jacks carry two normals each in effect: incurvationes.cpp:120 reads the first with getNormalVoltage(5) for the gain, and incurvationes.cpp:139 reads the same jack again with getNormalVoltage(2) for the internal oscillator's pitch, so an unpatched jack gives full gain and a fixed oscillator note. The maker credits this normalling to Warps's own cv_scaler and to a pull request by Brian Head against the Audible Instruments repository. Every per-channel read uses getVoltage(channel) rather than getPolyVoltage(channel), so a monophonic cable patched to a control voltage jack drives the first channel alone. The module has no right-click menu of its own beyond the plugin-wide theme entries.
